title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Member Discount on Ridgeline Special Order Services Home Delivery
content:
Members of Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards receive a member delivery discount on the home delivery charge of a delivered Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program paid in full at order.

**Clause.** The member delivery discount depends on the customer's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership: an active membership with at least 3 spend lines posted from special orders in the last 12 months gives a discount of 50 percent; an active membership with fewer than 3 such lines gives 10 percent; otherwise the member delivery discount is 0 percent.

The home delivery charge billed is multiplied by one minus the member delivery discount divided by 100, before its single rounding to the nearest cent.

## Records read

- **The membership** — the customer's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership and its status.
- **Spend lines from special orders** — the membership's spend-posted activity lines whose purchase channel is special order, dated within the last 12 months.

## Discount by membership record

| Membership status | Special-order spend lines in the last 12 months | Discount | Charge multiplied by |
|---|---|---|---|
| active | 3 or more | 50 percent | 0.5 |
| active | 0, 1 or 2 | 10 percent | 0.9 |
| pending verification, suspended or closed | any | 0 percent | 1 |
| no membership | — | 0 percent | 1 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical charge of 109.00 before the discount)

| Membership | Lines | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| active | 4 | 54.50 |
| active | 1 | 98.10 |
| suspended | 6 | 109.00 |
